headline: Executive order signed in 2009 aimed at increasing Asian American and Pacific Islander participation in federal programs.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to work on getting more Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders involved in federal programs. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, offices, or rules it sets up are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order aims to increase their participation in federal programs.
Agencies that run federal programs are likely expected to take steps to boost participation by these communities.
